title: TRIA ROXAS analysis metadata schema
description: Schema for ROXAS-specific analysis metadata for a TRIA dataset

outmost_year.title: Outmost year
outmost_year.description: Calendar year of the outermost ring. SH: year in which the growth began

origin_calibrated_x.title: Calibration origin X
origin_calibrated_x.description: X coordinate of the calibration origin [pixels]

origin_calibrated_y.title: Calibration origin Y
origin_calibrated_y.description: Y coordinate of the calibration origin [pixels]

circ_lower_limit.title: Lower limit circular sample
circ_lower_limit.description: Lower angular limit of circular sample sector [°]

circ_upper_limit.title: Upper limit circular sample
circ_upper_limit.description: Upper angular limit of circular sample sector [°]

cluster_dbl_cwt_threshold.title: Double cwt threshold
cluster_dbl_cwt_threshold.description: Threshold for detecting cell wall clusters [µm]

max_cwtrad_s.title: Max cwtrad of smallest tracheids
max_cwtrad_s.description: Max radial cwt of smallest tracheids [µm]

max_cwtrad_l.title: Max cwtrad of largest tracheids
max_cwtrad_l.description: Max radial cwt of largest tracheids [µm]

relwidth_cwt_window.title: Rel width of cwt retrieval window
relwidth_cwt_window.description: Width of cwt retrieval window as proportion of tracheid width/height

opposite_cwt_ratio_limit.title: Max ratio of opposing cwt
opposite_cwt_ratio_limit.description: Max ratio of the cwt of opposing walls

max_cwttan_s.title: Max cwttan of smallest tracheids
max_cwttan_s.description: Max tangential cwt of smallest tracheids [µm]

max_cwttan_l.title: Max cwttan of largest tracheids
max_cwttan_l.description: Max tangential cwt of largest tracheids [µm]

rw_reference_file.title: RW reference file
rw_reference_file.description: Filename of the ring width reference file
